name: Awesome Dioxus Components
description: The official source-owned Dioxus component registry.

items.name: cn
items.description: Small source-owned helper for composing Tailwind class fragments.

items.name: button
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style native button for Dioxus with typed variants and sizes.

documentation.compositionNote: Use caller-composed children for text, icons, and icon-plus-text content. `ButtonVariant` and `ButtonSize` mirror the current shadcn visual contract; native Dioxus button/global attributes and events are forwarded.
documentation.usage: Button { variant: ButtonVariant::Default, onclick: move |_| {}, "Save" }
documentation.accessibility: A native `<button>`; visible content is caller-composed through `children`, so text-only, icon-only, and icon-plus-text buttons all use the same accessible native control (`registry/ui/button.rs`). Icon-only usage should include an explicit `aria-label`.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling beyond native button activation (Enter/Space).

items.name: dialog
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus dialog backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; focus management, Escape, outside dismissal, and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives.
documentation.accessibility: `DialogContent` is `role="dialog"` with `aria-modal="true"`, labelled by its title and described by its description, and traps focus while open (`packages/adico-primitives/src/dialog.rs`). Unlike `alert-dialog`, it is dismissible by an outside click as well as Escape.
documentation.keyboard: Escape closes the dialog; the registry facade also wires a manual backdrop `onclick` handler as a documented workaround for `use_outside_dismiss`'s non-functional web listener registration.

items.name: select
items.description: A source-owned compositional select with keyboard navigation and typeahead.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade re-exports the owned Select parts; applications can style each primitive part directly with Dioxus class attributes while the runtime retains keyboard, typeahead, and ARIA behavior.
documentation.accessibility: Implements the WAI-ARIA APG Listbox pattern: `SelectTrigger` is the APG's combobox-like button and `SelectList` is `role="listbox"`, anchored to the trigger via `Positioner` (`packages/adico-primitives/src/select.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Full keyboard support: arrow keys navigate options, Home/End jump to the ends, Enter selects, Escape closes; typeahead lets typing jump to a matching option.

items.name: badge
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style status/label badge for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational status/category label. BadgeVariant covers upstream's Default/Secondary/Destructive/Outline plus two adico-only additions: Ghost/Link (closed as a real 5.2b gap) and Verified (a positive-status variant matching the Dioxus Components catalog, with no shadcn equivalent).
documentation.usage: Badge { variant: BadgeVariant::Secondary, "New" }
documentation.accessibility: Renders as inline content with no assigned role (`registry/ui/badge.rs`); its text is read as ordinary content by assistive technology. Use a visually-hidden prefix (e.g. "Status:") if the badge conveys state that isn't obvious from surrounding context.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; not an interactive control.

items.name: card
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style card shell composition for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational composition (Card/CardHeader/CardTitle/CardDescription/CardAction/CardContent/CardFooter), matching upstream's own non-interactive implementation.
documentation.accessibility: A plain styled `<div>` composition with no assigned ARIA role (`registry/ui/card.rs`); heading semantics for `CardTitle` are the caller's responsibility if the card content needs a document-outline heading.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; not an interactive control on its own.

items.name: input
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style single-line text input for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: A styled native <input>, forwarding native attributes/events; the semantic-invalid presentation is driven by the `invalid` prop alongside native `aria-invalid`.
documentation.usage: Input { placeholder: "Email", oninput: move |event| value.set(event.value()) }
documentation.accessibility: A native `<input>` with `aria-invalid` reflecting the `invalid` prop (`registry/ui/input.rs`); accessible naming is the caller's responsibility via an associated `Label` or `aria-label`.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling beyond native text-input behavior.

items.name: item
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Item composition for rows of media, content, and actions.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational composition (ItemGroup/Item/ItemMedia/ItemContent/ItemTitle/ItemDescription/ItemActions/ItemSeparator/ItemHeader/ItemFooter). ItemVariant::Interactive is the only variant that changes semantics (adds a roving tabindex hook via `tabindex`), matching upstream's own interactive-vs-static Item distinction.
documentation.accessibility: `ItemGroup` renders `role="list"`; each `Item` is `role="listitem"` with `aria-disabled` reflecting its `disabled` prop; `ItemSeparator` renders `role="separator"` (`registry/ui/item.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: An `Interactive`-variant `Item` gets `tabindex="0"` (others get `-1`); it carries no built-in activation handler of its own -- the caller wires `onclick`/`onkeydown` as needed.

items.name: pagination
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Pagination composition with configurable native links.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational nav (Pagination/PaginationContent/PaginationItem/PaginationLink/PaginationPrevious/PaginationNext/PaginationEllipsis), matching upstream's own non-interactive implementation -- links are plain anchors/buttons, page-change wiring is caller-composed.
documentation.accessibility: The root is `<nav role="navigation" aria-label="pagination">`; the active `PaginationLink` carries `aria-current="page"`; decorative previous/next glyphs are `aria-hidden` (`registry/ui/pagination.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Links render as native anchors/buttons; Tab moves between them and Enter activates the focused one, with no additional roving-focus behavior of its own.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style pulsing loading placeholder for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational loading placeholder. SkeletonVariant covers upstream's rectangular (Default) and circular (Circle) shapes; `decorative` (default true) sets `aria-hidden` so a loading placeholder is not announced as content.
documentation.usage: Skeleton { class: "h-4 w-32" }
documentation.accessibility: Sets `aria-hidden` when `decorative` (the default), so a loading placeholder is not announced as content by assistive technology (`registry/ui/skeleton.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; not an interactive control.

items.name: textarea
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style multi-line text input for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: A styled native <textarea>, forwarding native attributes/events; the semantic-invalid presentation is driven by the `invalid` prop alongside native `aria-invalid`.
documentation.usage: Textarea { placeholder: "Message", rows: 4, oninput: move |event| value.set(event.value()) }
documentation.accessibility: A native `<textarea>` with `aria-invalid` reflecting the `invalid` prop (`registry/ui/textarea.rs`); accessible naming is the caller's responsibility via an associated `Label` or `aria-label`.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling beyond native multi-line text-input behavior.

items.name: sheet
items.description: A source-owned slide-in Sheet for Dioxus, composing the owned Dialog primitive.

documentation.compositionNote: Composes the owned dialog primitive directly (SheetTitle/SheetDescription/Sheet re-export the Dialog primitive's parts); the styled wrapper only adds the slide-in side variant and positioning.
documentation.accessibility: Composes `packages/adico-primitives/src/dialog.rs` directly (the same `role="dialog"`/`aria-modal="true"`/focus-trap behavior as `Dialog`), styled as an edge-anchored panel instead of a centered modal.
documentation.keyboard: Same as `Dialog`: Escape closes it, plus the registry facade's manual backdrop `onclick` workaround for the same `use_outside_dismiss` web defect.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus tooltip backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; hover/focus/Escape handling and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives. Positioning is CSS-only via data-side/data-align attributes, matching the real upstream implementation (no portal or JS positioning engine).
documentation.accessibility: `TooltipTrigger` is described by a `role="tooltip"` `TooltipContent` via `aria-describedby`, per the WAI-ARIA APG Tooltip pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/tooltip.rs`); positioned relative to the trigger by the shared `Positioner`.
documentation.keyboard: Shown on hover or focus of the trigger, dismissed on Escape or on blur/mouse-leave.

items.name: popover
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus popover backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; focus trapping, Escape, outside dismissal, and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives (reusing the same use_focus_trap/FocusTrapScript internals as dialog).
documentation.accessibility: Follows the closest APG guidance -- the Dialog pattern -- applied conditionally: `PopoverContent` renders `role="dialog"` with `aria-modal="true"` and focus-trapping only when `is_modal` is set (the default); otherwise it is a non-modal disclosure (`packages/adico-primitives/src/popover.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Escape closes it and (when modal) focus is trapped inside; outside-click dismissal shares the confirmed, unfixed `document::eval` persistent-listener defect this session directly reproduced (see tasks.md 7.4f) -- verified working via `use_scroll_lock`-style fire-and-forget evals only, not this pattern.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus hover card backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; hover/focus handling and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives.
documentation.accessibility: Follows the closest APG guidance -- the Tooltip pattern's hover/focus-triggered, `aria-describedby`-linked disclosure -- while deliberately diverging where a card needs richer behavior a plain tooltip does not: `HoverCardContent` accepts focusable interactive children and stays open while the pointer is over the content itself (`packages/adico-primitives/src/hover_card.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Opens on hover or focus of the trigger, closes on Escape or moving away from both trigger and content. Note: `force_mount` does not actually keep closed content mounted on any target -- a known, documented primitive defect, not something a consumer should rely on.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: A source-owned compositional dropdown menu with roving-focus keyboard navigation.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade re-exports the owned DropdownMenu parts unstyled, matching select's approach: DropdownMenuItem is generic, so applications style each primitive part directly with Dioxus class attributes while the runtime retains roving-focus keyboard and ARIA behavior.
documentation.accessibility: `DropdownMenu`/`DropdownMenuTrigger`/`DropdownMenuContent`/`DropdownMenuItem` are direct re-exports of the shared `menu::Menu`/`MenuTrigger`/`MenuContent`/`MenuItem` primitive (`packages/adico-primitives/src/menu.rs`), matching Base UI's own anatomy where `Menu` *is* the dropdown menu -- `role="menu"`/`role="menuitem"` content on a roving-focus/dismissable-layer stack shared with `dialog`/`popover`.
documentation.keyboard: Arrow keys navigate items, Enter/Space activates the focused item, `ArrowRight`/`ArrowLeft` open/close submenus (`MenuSubmenuTrigger`); submenu hover-intent delay is not implemented, only click and arrow-key open/close.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus context menu backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; right-click/long-press detection, positioning, roving-focus keyboard navigation, and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives.
documentation.accessibility: No dedicated APG "Context Menu" pattern exists; `ContextMenuContent` implements the generic Menu pattern (`role="menu"`/`role="menuitem"`) opened by right-click or (touch/pen) long-press, with click-point `position: fixed` placement and Safari viewport correction (`packages/adico-primitives/src/context_menu.rs`). Deliberately independent of the shared `menu` primitive -- it owns placement/scroll-suppression/outside-dismiss concerns `menu::MenuContent` has no props for.
documentation.keyboard: Standard menu keyboard navigation (arrow keys move among items, Enter/Space activates); outside-click dismissal shares the same unfixed `document::eval` persistent-listener defect as this crate's other overlays -- confirmed via live instrumentation, see this change's tasks.md 7.4f note.

items.name: menubar
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus menubar backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; coordinated multi-menu roving-focus keyboard navigation and ARIA wiring remain inside adico-primitives.
documentation.accessibility: `role="menubar"` roving-focus container of `role="menu"` menus, each opened by a `role="menuitem"` trigger, per the WAI-ARIA APG Menubar pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/menubar.rs`). Deliberately independent of the shared `menu` primitive -- Base UI's own `Menubar` shares only a roving-focus container with `Menu`, not `Content`/`Item`.
documentation.keyboard: Only one menu is open at a time; `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight` move focus between menu triggers (open or not); Enter/Space/ArrowDown open the focused menu.

items.name: combobox
items.description: A source-owned compositional autocomplete input with a filterable popup list.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade re-exports the owned Combobox parts unstyled, matching select's approach: ComboboxOption is generic, so applications style each primitive part directly with Dioxus class attributes while the runtime retains filtering, roving-focus keyboard, and ARIA behavior.
documentation.accessibility: Implements the WAI-ARIA APG Combobox (listbox popup) pattern: a text input that filters an anchored `role="listbox"` popup while real DOM focus stays on the input -- navigation moves `aria-activedescendant`, not focus itself (`packages/adico-primitives/src/combobox.rs`). The popup is anchored via `Positioner` and dismissed via the shared layer/Escape/outside-dismiss stack.
documentation.keyboard: Arrow keys move the active descendant through filtered options while focus remains on the input; Enter commits the active option; Escape dismisses the popup (outside-click dismissal on `web` shares the known, unfixed `document::eval` listener defect recorded for this crate's other overlays).

items.name: calendar
items.description: A source-owned compositional date-grid calendar with single and range selection.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade styles the month view, navigation, title, and generated date grid with semantic shadcn tokens while the owned primitive retains single/range selection, constraints, keyboard navigation, focus, and ARIA behavior. Less common month/year selector parts remain composable exports.
documentation.usage: Calendar { value: value(), on_value_change: move |v| value.set(v) }
documentation.accessibility: `CalendarGridRoot` is `role="grid"`, each week is `role="row"`, and each day is a focusable button whose label states its full weekday/month/day/year; the weekday header row is `aria-hidden` since each day's own label already carries the weekday; the month/year heading is `role="heading" aria-level="2"` (`packages/adico-primitives/src/calendar.rs`, WAI-ARIA APG Grid pattern).
documentation.keyboard: Days share a single-tab-stop roving tabindex with arrow-key navigation across the grid; `RangeCalendar` additionally exposes `data-selection-start`/`data-selection-between`/`data-selection-end` per day for a two-endpoint range.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: A source-owned compositional date and date-range picker, composing the owned calendar and popover primitives.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade composes the installed semantic Calendar and Popover façades over the owned DatePicker primitive. The primitive retains typed date/range state, constraints, keyboard focus, dismissal, and ARIA behavior.
documentation.accessibility: No dedicated APG "Date Picker" pattern exists; `DatePicker`/`DateRangePicker` render a composite `role="group"` field containing one `role="spinbutton"` segment per year/month/day, each with `aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax`/`aria-valuenow` (the APG Spin Button pattern applied per segment). `DatePickerSeparator` is `aria-hidden` (`packages/adico-primitives/src/date_picker.rs`). The popup composes this crate's `calendar` (Grid pattern) and `popover` primitives.
documentation.keyboard: Arrow keys increment/decrement the focused segment; the popover calendar shares `calendar`'s own roving-tabindex day navigation once opened.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: A source-owned collapsible sidebar layout composition for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Unlike most registry items, upstream ships Sidebar as a styled preview component rather than an adico-primitives module; its only shared state is a plain open/closed signal from adico_primitives::use_controlled, and it composes the owned separator primitive directly. This initial pass renders one CSS-driven collapsible layout rather than upstream's document::eval-detected mobile sheet mode (that eval pattern was found non-functional while testing the Wave 3 overlay batch); a real viewport-driven mobile mode is deferred to M4/M5.
documentation.accessibility: `SidebarSeparator` composes `adico_primitives::separator::Separator` (`role="separator"`/`aria-orientation`, or `role="none"` when decorative); the rest of the composition is plain styled markup (`registry/ui/sidebar.rs`). No mobile/responsive viewport-driven collapse mode exists yet -- a named, deferred gap (see this file's own module doc).
documentation.keyboard: No dedicated keyboard-navigation layer of its own beyond native focus order through its composed buttons/links.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.description: A source-owned CSS aspect-ratio wrapper for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: A pure re-export of the owned AspectRatio primitive: a CSS padding-bottom ratio wrapper with no visual styling to compose, matching upstream's own unstyled behavior.
documentation.accessibility: No ARIA role applies -- a layout container is not itself a widget (`packages/adico-primitives/src/aspect_ratio.rs`). Accessibility of the ratio-constrained content (e.g. an ``'s `alt` text) remains the caller's responsibility.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; purely layout.

items.name: label
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Label for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned `for`/`id` association primitive. Composes with any installed form control via matching `html_for`/`id` values.
documentation.usage: Label { html_for: "email", "Email address" }
documentation.accessibility: Renders a native `<label for>`, which every assistive technology already understands without an ARIA role (`packages/adico-primitives/src/label.rs`). Must be associated with a form control via `html_for`.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; clicking a label natively focuses/activates its associated control.

items.name: progress
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Progress bar for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned ARIA progressbar primitive. The indicator's fill width is CSS-transform-driven from the primitive's --progress-value custom property; a `None` value renders a zero-filled indeterminate bar rather than upstream's unstyled indeterminate state, since animated indeterminate styling is M4's job.
documentation.accessibility: `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax`/`aria-valuenow`, omitting `aria-valuenow` for an indeterminate progress indicator when `value` is `None`, per the WAI-ARIA APG Meter/Progressbar pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/progress.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; a progress indicator is not an interactive control.

items.name: avatar
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Avatar for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned image-load-state primitive: Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarFallback. AvatarImage stops rendering on error so an installed AvatarFallback (bg-muted) takes over automatically.
documentation.accessibility: No dedicated WAI-ARIA APG pattern exists for an avatar; `AvatarImage` renders `role="img"`, the closest APG guidance for a single meaningful graphic with a fallback (`packages/adico-primitives/src/avatar.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; the avatar itself is not an interactive control.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Checkbox for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned keyboard/ARIA checkbox primitive (checked/indeterminate/unchecked), with a Lucide Check indicator. Requires the web feature since the primitive's hidden bubble input needs the browser DOM to sync indeterminate state.
documentation.usage: Checkbox { checked: checked(), on_checked_change: move |v| checked.set(v) }
documentation.accessibility: `role="checkbox"` with `aria-checked` of `true`/`false`/`mixed` (tri-state support), per the WAI-ARIA APG Checkbox pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/checkbox.rs`). A hidden native `<input type="checkbox">` mirrors state for plain HTML form submission.
documentation.keyboard: Toggles only on Space, not Enter -- the APG reserves Enter for a form's default-submit button, not checkbox activation.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: A source-owned Collapsible for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: A pure re-export of the owned Collapsible/CollapsibleContent/CollapsibleTrigger primitive: upstream ships it unstyled, matching shadcn's own unstyled Collapsible -- layout is left to consumer composition.
documentation.accessibility: `CollapsibleTrigger`/`CollapsibleContent` implement the APG disclosure-widget guidance: a trigger with `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` pointing at the content it reveals (`packages/adico-primitives/src/collapsible.rs`). `keep_mounted` keeps content in the DOM with no ARIA/visibility guarantee of its own -- visibility when set is the caller's own CSS/`hidden` attribute.
documentation.keyboard: `CollapsibleTrigger` is a native button; Enter/Space toggle it via ordinary button activation, with no additional roving-focus or arrow-key behavior.

items.name: switch
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Switch for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned keyboard/ARIA switch primitive, composing SwitchThumb with a translate-x thumb animation driven by data-state.
documentation.usage: Switch { checked: checked(), on_checked_change: move |v| checked.set(v) }
documentation.accessibility: `role="switch"` with `aria-checked`, per the WAI-ARIA APG Switch pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/switch.rs`). A hidden native `<input type="checkbox">` mirrors state for plain HTML form submission.
documentation.keyboard: Toggles only on Space, not Enter -- matching the APG's guidance that a switch behaves like a checkbox for activation, not a button.

items.name: toggle
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Toggle for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned pressed-state ARIA button primitive, with sm/default/lg size variants matching shadcn's Toggle.
documentation.usage: Toggle { pressed: pressed(), on_pressed_change: move |v| pressed.set(v), "Bold" }
documentation.accessibility: A native `<button>` with `aria-pressed`, per the WAI-ARIA APG Button pattern's pressed-state variant (`packages/adico-primitives/src/toggle.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Toggles on click/Enter/Space (native button activation); includes an explicit-focus-after-click workaround for Safari/Firefox on macOS not focusing `<button>` on click by default.

items.name: accordion
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Accordion for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned roving-focus collapsible-group primitive (reuses the collection infrastructure already imported for Select). Composes a Lucide ChevronDown indicator into the trigger, matching shadcn's Accordion.
documentation.accessibility: Each `AccordionTrigger` is a native `<button>` with `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` pointing at its `AccordionContent` (`packages/adico-primitives/src/accordion.rs`). `Accordion`/`AccordionMulti` implement the WAI-ARIA APG Accordion pattern's single- vs. multiple-open-panel variants.
documentation.keyboard: Triggers share a single-tab-stop roving tabindex: arrow keys move focus along the accordion, Home/End jump to the first/last trigger, Enter/Space (native button activation) toggles the focused panel.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Radio Group for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned roving-focus radio primitive (reuses the collection infrastructure already imported for Select), with a CSS-only checked indicator dot.
documentation.accessibility: `role="radiogroup"` containing `role="radio"` items, per the WAI-ARIA APG Radio Group pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/radio_group.rs`). With nothing yet selected, every radio stays in the tab order until one is focused or checked, matching native radio-group semantics rather than a plain listbox's default-first-item focus.
documentation.keyboard: Single-tab-stop roving tabindex: arrow keys move focus *and* select, along the group's orientation; Home/End jump to the ends and select.

items.name: tabs
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Tabs for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned roving-focus tab-list primitive (reuses the collection infrastructure already imported for Select), matching shadcn's Tabs.
documentation.accessibility: `TabList` is `role="tablist"`, each `TabTrigger` is `role="tab"`, and each `TabContent` is `role="tabpanel"`, rendered (not just hidden) only while its trigger is selected -- automatic activation, per the WAI-ARIA APG Tabs pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/tabs.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Single-tab-stop roving tabindex among triggers: arrow keys move along the tab list's orientation, Home/End jump to the ends; moving focus also activates the panel (automatic activation).

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Toggle Group for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned roving-focus toggle-group primitive (reuses the collection infrastructure already imported for Select and composes the owned Toggle primitive directly), matching shadcn's Toggle Group.
documentation.accessibility: Each `ToggleItem` composes `toggle.rs`'s own `Toggle` (an APG "Button" with `aria-pressed`); the group itself adds WAI-ARIA APG Toolbar-shaped roving-tabindex semantics plus single-/multiple-pressed selection state (`packages/adico-primitives/src/toggle_group.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Single-tab-stop roving tabindex: arrow keys move focus along the group's orientation; Enter/Space (native button activation) toggles the focused item.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: A source-owned custom-scrollbar Scroll Area for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: A pure re-export of the owned ScrollArea primitive: pure CSS overflow/scrollbar-width styling with no visual language to compose, matching upstream's own unstyled behavior.
documentation.accessibility: No ARIA role applies -- a scrollable container is not itself a widget (`packages/adico-primitives/src/scroll_area.rs`); its spec is pure CSS overflow/scrollbar-width composition.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; native scroll keys (arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Space) work once the scrollable region has focus, same as any native overflow container.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Alert Dialog composition for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: The public copied API remains compositional; focus-trap handling is delegated to the same shared internals the installed Dialog uses. AlertDialogTrigger (composing the installed Button, matching DialogTrigger) is nested inside AlertDialog so the root-level Escape handler reliably receives keyboard events; Escape is handled on AlertDialogRoot itself, the same working position DialogRoot uses. Unlike Dialog, no outside-dismiss listener is installed, matching the WAI-ARIA alertdialog pattern's requirement that only an explicit action can close it.
documentation.accessibility: `AlertDialogContent` is `role="alertdialog"` with `aria-modal="true"`, labelled by its title and described by its description, and traps focus while open (`packages/adico-primitives/src/alert_dialog.rs`). Unlike `dialog`, it is deliberately not dismissible by an outside click, matching the WAI-ARIA APG Alert Dialog pattern's requirement for an explicit response.
documentation.keyboard: Escape closes it via a native `onkeydown` handler on `AlertDialogRoot` itself (moved there after live testing found a content-scoped listener never received the keydown while focus stayed on the trigger).

items.name: toast
items.description: A source-owned Toast notification system for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Only the toast region's fixed viewport placement is styled by default (structural, not cosmetic); individual toast cards keep the primitive's own unstyled composition, matching this registry's existing many-parts-unstyled precedent for Select/Combobox. A full default visual style for Toast itself is M4's job.
documentation.accessibility: Each `Toast` is `role="alertdialog"` wrapping a `role="alert"` live region, per the WAI-ARIA APG "alert" pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/toast.rs`); `ToastProvider` manages a shared notification queue with no APG pattern of its own.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling beyond a global keydown listener used for dismissal; individual toast dismissal is otherwise pointer/timer-driven (auto-dismiss timer per toast).

items.name: slider
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Slider for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned pointer-drag/keyboard value primitive. Pointer-drag interaction depends on the web feature (pointer tracking is a no-op on the native default); keyboard arrow-key interaction works on every target. Desktop pointer-capture behavior is compiled but not independently verified against a real desktop WebView, a named and recorded gap.
documentation.accessibility: Each `SliderThumb` is `role="slider"` with `aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax`/`aria-valuenow`, per the WAI-ARIA APG Slider pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/slider.rs`). `RangeSlider` composes two independently-clamped thumbs for the pattern's two-thumb range-selection variant.
documentation.keyboard: Arrow keys move the focused thumb by `step`, or 10x `step` with Shift held; pointer-dragging along the track is also supported (desktop pointer-capture is compiled but not independently browser-verified).

items.name: toolbar
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Toolbar component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` per statics/catalogs/dioxus-components.json and tracked in statics/component_compatibility.json, not shadcn parity. Roving-focus button/separator container, similar shape to Menubar without layered popups. No document::eval or DOM measurement, SSR-safe by construction.
documentation.accessibility: `data-orientation`/`data-disabled` on the root, per the WAI-ARIA APG Toolbar pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/toolbar.rs`); `ToolbarSeparator` renders `role="separator"`/`aria-orientation` (or `role="none"` when decorative).
documentation.keyboard: Single-tab-stop roving tabindex among `ToolbarButton`s: arrow keys move focus along the toolbar's orientation.

items.name: virtual-list
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only VirtualList component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` per statics/catalogs/dioxus-components.json and tracked in statics/component_compatibility.json, not shadcn parity. Pure re-export: upstream ships it unstyled, list-item content is entirely caller-composed, and the caller must give the container a bounded height (for example `style: "height: 300px; overflow-y: auto;"`) or the viewport measurement equals the full content height and nothing is virtualized. Its scroll/resize bridge uses native `onscroll`/`onmounted` element queries (no `web`/`desktop` feature gate needed, unlike other overlay primitives) after live browser testing found upstream's own `document::eval`-based bridge never registers in this Dioxus 0.7.9/0.7.10 web runtime -- see provenance. On a renderer without `onscroll`/`onmounted` support (native/server) it renders zero items rather than failing to build -- a documented, explicit target-support skip, not silent, until a proper observer-bridge primitive exists (M6 territory).
documentation.accessibility: Renders `role="list"`/`role="listitem"` with `aria-setsize`/`aria-posinset` so a screen reader announces the true list size despite only a slice being rendered in the DOM (`packages/adico-primitives/src/virtual_list.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; native scroll keys work once the scrollable region has focus, same as `scroll-area`.

items.name: color-picker
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Color Picker component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` per statics/catalogs/dioxus-components.json and tracked in statics/component_compatibility.json, not shadcn parity. HSV saturation/value drag surface with keyboard arrow-key navigation and accessible per-axis range inputs (AreaThumbSaturationInput/AreaThumbValueInput). The M3 migration queue's dependency note said this item composes label/popover/slider; reading the actual upstream primitive source found it only depends on the already-owned move_interaction/pointer modules (reused unmodified from Wave 2's Slider import), not those three registry items -- a real correction recorded per the M1 lesson to verify against source, not the queue's one-line notes. Requires the `palette` crate directly (matching upstream's own public HSV color type in its props), same as any upstream consumer. **2026-09-02:** the 'not slider' half of that correction no longer holds -- this item now genuinely composes the `slider` registry item for a new `HueSlider` sub-component (task 5.3h: `ColorArea` only ever adjusted saturation/value within a fixed hue, with no control anywhere that changed hue itself; a user directly asked how to pick red and there was no way through the UI). `registryDependencies` is now `["cn", "slider"]`. The original M3 finding about `move_interaction`/`pointer` is unaffected and still accurate -- only the slider composition premise changed, and only because new functionality was added, not because the earlier finding was wrong.
documentation.accessibility: No dedicated APG "Color Picker" pattern exists; this follows the closest guidance -- the Slider pattern applied per axis. `ColorPicker`/`ColorArea` are `role="group"`; each saturation/value axis input is a native `type="range"` with a human-readable `aria-valuetext` (e.g. "Saturation 62%, vibrant orange") and `aria-orientation` (`packages/adico-primitives/src/color_picker.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: `AreaThumb` is the two-dimensional drag surface and keyboard entry point, handing focus to whichever axis input the keypress moved; each axis then responds to its own arrow keys like an ordinary range input.

items.name: drag-and-drop-list
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Drag And Drop List component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` per statics/catalogs/dioxus-components.json and tracked in statics/component_compatibility.json, not shadcn parity. Pointer-drag list reordering that reuses the roving-focus collection infrastructure already imported for Select. Keyboard reordering (Enter to lift/drop, Arrow keys to move, Escape to cancel, Delete/Backspace to remove) is the always-tested accessible path. Native pointer/mouse drag-and-drop is compiled and wired but not independently browser-verified -- a named risk carried since the M3 migration queue, the same open question as Slider's unverified desktop pointer-capture behavior.
documentation.accessibility: No dedicated APG "Drag and Drop" pattern exists; each item is a keyboard-operable (single-tab-stop roving tabindex) `<li aria-roledescription="sortable item" aria-grabbed>`, the list is `<ul aria-roledescription="sortable list" aria-describedby>` pointing at visually-hidden instructions, and every lift/move/drop/cancel is announced through a `role="status" aria-live="assertive"` live region (`packages/adico-primitives/src/drag_and_drop_list.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Enter lifts/drops an item, Arrow keys move it, Escape cancels, Delete/Backspace removes it -- the always-tested primary interaction path. Native pointer/mouse HTML5 drag-and-drop is also implemented but not independently browser-verified.

items.name: tag-group
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Tag Group component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` per statics/catalogs/dioxus-components.json and tracked in statics/component_compatibility.json, not shadcn parity. Grouped multi-select tag input reusing the roving-focus collection infrastructure already imported for Select; no document::eval, portal, or DOM measurement API, so it is SSR-safe by construction.
documentation.accessibility: Implements the WAI-ARIA APG Grid pattern (a single-row-per-item grid, not a listbox): `TagList` is `role="grid"`, each `TagOption` is `role="row"`/`role="gridcell"` (`packages/adico-primitives/src/tag_group.rs`). Escape-clears-selection and roving `aria-rowindex` are this file's own design, informed by shadcn/Base UI conventions rather than an ARIA-authored precedent.
documentation.keyboard: Arrow keys move roving focus among tags; Escape clears the current selection; each tag's own `TagRemoveButton` is independently focusable/activatable for keyboard removal.

items.name: mode-toggle
items.description: A source-owned Light/Dark/System theme toggle for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Composes the installed dropdown-menu registry item with adico_primitives::theme_mode for Light/Dark/System selection. Persists the selection (localStorage on web, a preferences file on desktop) and applies the resolved appearance's class to the document root automatically. Classified `EXISTING_SHADCN_EQUIVALENT`-adjacent -- shadcn's theming docs ship an equivalent Light/Dark/System dropdown pattern; see statics/component_compatibility.json and design.md §7b.
documentation.usage: ModeToggle {}
documentation.accessibility: Composes the installed `DropdownMenuTrigger` (a `Button`) and `theme_mode`'s `ThemeMode`/`ResolvedTheme` resolution (`packages/adico-primitives/src/theme_mode.rs`); its own accessibility surface is entirely the composed `DropdownMenu`'s (`role="menu"`/`role="menuitem"`).
documentation.keyboard: Same as `DropdownMenu`: arrow keys navigate the light/dark/system options, Enter/Space selects one.

items.name: theme-switcher
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only palette switcher for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus-only extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA`-style per design.md §7b (no shadcn/dioxus-components catalog counterpart in statics/component_compatibility.json). A distilled palette picker (Slate/Blue/Violet/Emerald/Rose/Amber presets recoloring --primary/--primary-foreground and their Tailwind aliases) productizing the concept prototyped in apps/playground's advanced customization tray, which keeps its own full 28-token editor unchanged.
documentation.usage: ThemeSwitcher {}
documentation.accessibility: Composes `theme_mode`'s `ThemeMode`/`ResolvedTheme` resolution (`packages/adico-primitives/src/theme_mode.rs`) behind a styled `Button`-like trigger; its accessibility surface is a native button's.
documentation.keyboard: Native button activation (Enter/Space); no custom keyboard layer.

items.name: theme-builder
items.description: A source-owned Dioxus-only full theme customization builder for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus-only extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` per design.md §7d (no shadcn/dioxus-components catalog counterpart in statics/component_compatibility.json). Promotes apps/playground's advanced customization tray -- the full 28-semantic-token editor with independent light/dark values, a deterministic 'generate theme' action, and CSS export -- into a real, generic, installable component, since none of it is actually playground-specific in nature. Applies its edited tokens live through adico_primitives::theme_mode::apply_root_properties, the same document-root mechanism theme-switcher already uses for its 4 properties, so theme-builder composes with mode-toggle/theme-switcher on one mechanism. Renders its CSS export into a read-only, selectable textarea rather than calling the browser clipboard API directly, so it stays free of browser-interop details and needs no new cargo dependencies.
documentation.usage: ThemeBuilderLauncher {}
documentation.accessibility: A styled composition around `theme_mode`'s `ThemeMode` primitive (`packages/adico-primitives/src/theme_mode.rs`); its editable token controls and CSS-export text area are plain form controls with native semantics, no custom ARIA widget roles.
documentation.keyboard: No custom keyboard layer; native form-control and button keyboard behavior throughout.

items.name: alert
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Alert for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational, no shared behavior to delegate: Alert/AlertTitle/AlertDescription are static content-box slots, matching upstream's own non-interactive implementation. Alert sets role="alert" directly.
documentation.accessibility: Renders a native `role="alert"` live region (`registry/ui/alert.rs`), so assistive technology announces its content when it appears without requiring focus to move.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; purely presentational.

items.name: empty
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Empty state placeholder for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational: Empty/EmptyHeader/EmptyMedia/EmptyTitle/EmptyDescription/EmptyContent are static content-box slots for zero-data states, matching upstream's own non-interactive implementation.
documentation.accessibility: A plain styled composition with no assigned ARIA role (`registry/ui/empty.rs`); if the empty state replaces a live list/table, consider announcing the change via a live region at the call site.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; purely presentational.

items.name: kbd
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Kbd (keyboard key) for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational (Kbd/KbdGroup), rendering the native `<kbd>` element shadcn itself uses -- no ARIA role needed since assistive technology already recognizes `<kbd>` as keyboard input.
documentation.accessibility: Renders the native `<kbd>` element, which assistive technology already recognizes as denoting keyboard input without any ARIA role needed (`registry/ui/kbd.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; purely presentational (it labels a shortcut, it does not implement one).

items.name: spinner
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Spinner loading indicator for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Renders the owned Lucide LoaderCircle icon re-export directly (matching upstream's Loader2Icon usage) with role="status"; no interactive behavior of its own.
documentation.usage: Spinner {}
documentation.accessibility: Renders a native `role="status"` live region with `aria-label="Loading"` (`registry/ui/spinner.rs`), so assistive technology announces the loading state without requiring focus.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; not an interactive control.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Breadcrumb navigation trail for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational nav trail (Breadcrumb/BreadcrumbList/BreadcrumbItem/BreadcrumbLink/BreadcrumbPage/BreadcrumbSeparator/BreadcrumbEllipsis), matching upstream's own non-interactive implementation. BreadcrumbSeparator defaults to a ChevronRight icon; BreadcrumbEllipsis renders the owned Lucide Ellipsis re-export (this icon set's current name for upstream's MoreHorizontalIcon, which Lucide itself renamed).
documentation.accessibility: The root is `<nav aria-label="breadcrumb">`; the current page carries `aria-current="page"` and `role="link"`/`aria-disabled="true"` (it is not a real link); separators and the ellipsis are `aria-hidden`/`role="presentation"` (`registry/ui/breadcrumb.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: `BreadcrumbLink` renders a native `<a>`, so Tab/Enter follow ordinary link semantics; there is no component-specific keyboard handling beyond that.

items.name: table
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style Table for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational (Table/TableHeader/TableBody/TableFooter/TableRow/TableHead/TableCell/TableCaption), matching upstream's own non-interactive implementation. Table wraps the real <table> in a relative/overflow-x-auto scroll container, matching upstream's horizontal-scroll behavior for wide tables.
documentation.accessibility: Plain native `<table>` markup with semantic `<thead>`/`<tbody>`/`<tfoot>`/`<th>`/`<td>` (`registry/ui/table.rs`); `TableRow`'s classes include a `[role=checkbox]` hook for a selection-column pattern, but selection state itself is caller-composed.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; native table semantics only (no roving-focus cell navigation).

items.name: button-group
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style ButtonGroup for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Visually joins related buttons/form controls (ButtonGroup/ButtonGroupText/ButtonGroupSeparator) via adjoining borders/radii, matching upstream's cva-driven orientation variant with a plain Rust enum instead. ButtonGroupSeparator composes the owned adico_primitives::separator::Separator primitive, matching how ToolbarSeparator composes its own primitive counterpart.
documentation.accessibility: `ButtonGroup` renders `role="group"` with `data-orientation` (`registry/ui/button_group.rs`). `ButtonGroupSeparator` composes `adico_primitives::separator::Separator`, which renders `role="separator"`/`aria-orientation` (or `role="none"` when decorative) per `packages/adico-primitives/src/separator.rs`.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling of its own; keyboard behavior belongs entirely to the composed children (typically `Button`s), each focusable and activated independently.

items.name: input-group
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style InputGroup for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: InputGroup/InputGroupAddon/InputGroupButton/InputGroupText/InputGroupInput/InputGroupTextarea replicate upstream's bordered-field-with-addons composition, including the has-[>[data-align=block-start/end]]:flex-col rule that switches the container to a column layout around a stacked textarea + addon (an initial pass dropped this, which visually broke into a one-character-wide textarea column -- caught by a live dx-serve check, not by compile-clean checks, and fixed). InputGroupButton reuses the installed Button's own ButtonVariant/ButtonSize enums directly (Ghost/Xs default) instead of a duplicate parallel size scale. InputGroupInput/InputGroupTextarea author their own flush classes rather than composing Input/Textarea, since adico_lib::cn has no Tailwind-merge equivalent to reliably override those components' fixed classes. InputGroupAddon omits upstream's click-to-focus-sibling-input JavaScript (a non-essential UX nicety); see the module doc comment.
documentation.accessibility: `InputGroup` renders `role="group"`; focus-visible and `aria-invalid` states on the contained control (identified via `data-slot="input-group-control"`) are reflected onto the group's own border/ring (`registry/ui/input_group.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; keyboard behavior belongs to the contained `InputGroupInput`/`InputGroupTextarea`/`InputGroupButton`, each a native form control or `Button`.

items.name: native-select
items.description: A source-owned shadcn-style NativeSelect for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Wraps a native <select> for OS-native picker behavior, distinct from the owned custom-listbox Select component. NativeSelectOption/NativeSelectOptGroup use the Canvas/CanvasText CSS system-color keywords (matching upstream exactly) rather than adico's background/foreground semantic tokens, since a native <option> popup is painted by the OS outside the page's own CSS custom properties -- not a token-compliance gap.
documentation.accessibility: Wraps a native `<select>` for OS-native picker behavior (`registry/ui/native_select.rs`); native `<select>` semantics (role, `aria-invalid` reflection) are provided by the browser itself, not reimplemented.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; relies entirely on the native `<select>`'s own keyboard behavior (arrow keys change the value, typing jumps to a matching option).
